title: Week 5: Recursion and Big-O
content:
This week we switch from using data structures to reasoning about them. Two ideas to carry:

  • recursion: a function that solves a smaller copy of the same problem, plus a base case that stops it
  • Big-O: how the work grows when the input grows, not how fast your laptop is

Read Chapter 5 before Friday. The worked examples (factorial, binary search) are the ones the homework builds on.
